meaning.vi: Rồi thành ra ~ (do hoàn cảnh, không phải tự mình quyết).
meaning.en: It turns out that ~ / comes to be decided that ~ (by circumstance).
meaning.th: กลายเป็นว่า ~ (ตามสถานการณ์)

meaning.vi: Chính ~ (nhấn mạnh, khẳng định đúng là cái đó).
meaning.th: ~ นั่นแหละ (เน้น)

meaning.vi: Dù ~ đi nữa (thì kết quả vẫn không đổi).
meaning.en: Even if / no matter ~ (the result stays the same).
meaning.th: แม้ว่า ~ ก็

meaning.vi: Nhất định không chịu ~ (ý chí của người khác, ngôi thứ ba).
meaning.en: Refuses to ~ / won't even try to ~ (someone else's will).

quiz.ja: 兄が村から逃げ出したのは、なぜですか。
choices: 妹を殺してしまったと思ったから
兵士になりたかったから
おじいさんにしかられたから

explain.vi: Vì tưởng mình đã lỡ tay giết em gái.
explain.en: He believed he had killed his sister.
explain.zh-Hans: 因为以为自己杀死了妹妹。
explain.tl: Akala niya ay napatay niya ang kapatid.
explain.pt: Achou que tinha matado a irmã.
explain.my: ညီမကို သတ်မိပြီထင်လို့။
explain.th: คิดว่าฆ่าน้องสาวตายแล้ว

quiz.ja: 夫は、何を見て妻が妹だと気づきましたか。

explain.vi: Vết sẹo cũ trên đầu khi chải tóc cho vợ.
explain.en: The old scar on her head, seen while combing her hair.
explain.zh-Hans: 梳头时看到的头上的旧伤疤。
explain.ko: 머리를 빗길 때 본 머리의 오래된 흉터.
explain.tl: Ang lumang peklat sa ulo habang sinusuklay.
explain.ne: कपाल कोर्दा देखेको टाउकोको पुरानो खत।
explain.id: Bekas luka lama di kepala saat menyisir.
explain.pt: A velha cicatriz na cabeça, ao penteá-la.
explain.my: ဆံပင်ဖြီးရင်း မြင်တဲ့ ခေါင်းက အမာရွတ်ဟောင်း။
explain.th: แผลเป็นเก่าบนศีรษะขณะหวีผม

quiz.ja: 「自分の妻（　）、あの日に死んだと思っていた妹だったのです。」
妻と子どもは、最後にどうなりましたか。
choices: 鳥になって飛んでいった

explain.vi: Hai mẹ con đứng chờ mãi rồi hóa đá trên núi.
explain.en: They waited so long they turned to stone on the mountain.
explain.zh-Hans: 母子在山上一直等待，化成了岩石。
explain.pt: Viraram pedra no alto da montanha.
explain.th: กลายเป็นหินบนภูเขา
